# Contributing

I would love to have you contribute to TACAOS! So I'm going to try and make it as easy as possible for both of us.

There is nothing specific relating to PRs or Issues other than doing it in good faith and providing as much information as possible.

## AI Contributiong

AI is an amazing tool. I really don't care how you use it, but I do care about the quality of your contributions. If you use AI to generate code, please ensure to review and understand it before submitting it. Also ensure that you are not violating any licenses or terms of service by using AI-generated code.

## Help Contributing

This section is more of to help you if you get confused or stuck. If you have any questions on contributing feel free to open an issue.
Otherwise this section (in future) will contain general help and information.
